name: rules-rtdb-r12-server-time-and-token
description: RTDB rules production verdicts for corpus scenario "r12-server-time-and-token" (rtdb#71). Captured by deploy-observe-restore (RTDB has no server-side rules test API). rules routinely gate writes on the server clock and on the sign-in provider carried in the ID token, and the token is also the only receiver production accepts the `[]` subscript on — the simulator must resolve `now`, the dotted claim path, and the indexed claim path the same way production does.
